title: Fullstack Engineer
description:
A rapidly growing, well-funded AI technology company transforming the video security industry through computer vision, machine learning and real-time intelligence.

They're expanding their London engineering team and seeking a talented Full Stack Software Engineer to build and scale their cloud-native AI platform.

Responsibilities

  • Develop scalable backend services using Golang and Python.
  • Build modern frontends with React and TypeScript.
  • Design APIs and distributed systems handling real-time video and sensor data.
  • Deliver AI-powered features, collaborating with product and ML engineers.
  • Take ownership of features from design through to production.

Requirements

  • Strong full stack engineering experience with React, TypeScript and backend development.
  • Experience with Go, Python or similar backend languages.
  • Knowledge of APIs, distributed systems and cloud technologies (AWS/Kubernetes advantageous).
  • Ideally experience within a startup, scale-up or high-growth environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical ownership and career progression.

Experience: 2-3+ years as a guide, with ability valued over tenure.

Benefits

  • Up to £100k salary + early-stage equity.
  • Cutting-edge AI technology and genuine engineering ownership.
  • Flexible holidays, team events and premium development tools.
  • Collaborative, ambitious engineering culture.

Working arrangement: Primarily office-based in Old Street, with occasional WFH flexibility.

*Rates depend on experience and client requirements
